text:
emily_partnerships: FYI partner is blocked on signing the Marketplace PO because their reseller/distributor flow creates a split-billing situation. Partner wants Redwood to accept a PO made out to their distributor (CloudResell Ltd) while the marketplace vendor profile is under PartnerCo UK. Partner says distributor is 'seller of record' for EMEA. cc @tara_procurement @alex_legal

rick_solutions: Do we have precedent for accepting distributor POs that don't match marketplace vendor? I thought marketplace required vendor = invoice issuer.

tara_procurement: Marketplace policy usually requires the invoice to come from the registered seller. We can accept distributor POs if vendor provides a signed reseller addendum plus supplier registration for the distributor. Need AP + tax sign-off.

emily_partnerships: Partner offered two paths: 1) list distributor as the billing entity on the marketplace (they can request a marketplace vendor change but said it takes 2-3 weeks) or 2) partner's distributor issues a commercial invoice to Redwood and partner provides a reseller agreement so marketplace records still attribute to PartnerCo. They prefer option 2 to close faster.

alex_legal: Option 2 is workable but we need: reseller agreement naming Redwood as covered customer, indemnity carveouts, and confirmation distributor is authorized to issue invoices on partner's behalf. Also include payment flow and assignment of rights for refunds/credits. I can spin a short reseller acknowledgement template.

jessica_marketing: Heads-up: joint announcement is scheduled next Monday for the marketplace launch. If PO doesn't clear this week we'll need to postpone press. Partner is pushing to keep dates.

tara_procurement: AP won't process distributor invoices without supplier onboarding + VAT docs. Also procurement needs PO to match accounting vendor for reconciliation. If we accept distributor invoice, we'll need to create a one-off supplier record for CloudResell Ltd (their EU VAT number required). That takes ~48 hours once docs are in.

emily_partnerships: Partner uploaded docs to the shared folder: reseller agreement draft, CloudResell VAT cert, distributor AP contact. Link: https://redwood.internal/partner-docs/partnerco-reseller.

rick_solutions: Can we do a short-term workaround: issue PO to CloudResell Ltd referencing Marketplace Deal ID and include a procurement exception memo? That plus reseller agreement would let AP process on expedited timeline.

tara_procurement: Yes, we can create a PO to CloudResell if legal signs off on the reseller wording and finance signs the one-off supplier onboarding. We can expedite to same-day if docs are complete, otherwise 48 hours.

alex_legal: I'll draft a 2-paragraph reseller acknowledgement today: authorization to invoice, confirmation of responsibility, and a 30-day catch-up clause to reconcile marketplace records. Will share for review.

finance-bot: SYSTEM: Supplier onboarding ticket #SO-8892 created for CloudResell Ltd. ETA: 48h unless expedited by procurement.

jessica_marketing: If we can get PO and proof of invoice this week, we'll keep the announcement date. If not, we'll move announcement to next cycle.

emily_partnerships: Summary and action items: 1) alex to send reseller acknowledgement template (today) 2) partner to confirm distributor invoice sample + upload VAT + AP contact (already uploaded) 3) tara to create procurement exception memo and request expedited supplier onboarding 4) rick to coordinate with partner for invoice routing 5) jessica to hold announcement contingent on PO cleared. Target: PO issued by Friday COB. :pray: 

tara_procurement: Noted. I'll mark the supplier ticket as high priority and route to AP lead.

alex_legal: Drafted ack and uploaded to drive: https://redwood.internal/legal/partnerco-reseller-ack.docx. Tagged emily & tara for review.

emily_partnerships: Partner confirmed distributor can send invoice once we provide PO. They're waiting on our procurement exception memo. I'll attach their invoice template to the ticket.

finance-bot: SYSTEM: AP processed supplier onboarding form for CloudResell Ltd. Status: pending tax verification.

emily_partnerships: Great progress. Will update when PO is published. If anyone sees additional blocker (contract language or tax), flag here and we'll escalate to VP Partnerships.

rick_solutions: Thanks team. Keeping pressure on partner to accept our small reseller wording. Rapid close should preserve the announcement timeline.

emily_partnerships: Closing notes: we'll re-open thread if onboarding/tax verification fails. For now, proceed with PO flow to CloudResell Ltd referencing marketplace deal ID. :white_check_mark:
